text:
```yaml
name: C# GSDK Unit Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'csharp/**'
      - '.github/workflows/csharp-tests.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up .NET 10.0 SDK
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
      with:
        dotnet-version: 10.0
        global-json-file: global.json

    - name: Build solution
      run: dotnet build GSDK_CSharp_Standard.sln --configuration Release

    - name: Run tests
      run: dotnet test csharp/Tests/Tests.csproj --configuration Release --logger "trx;LogFileName=test-results.trx"

    - name: Upload test results
      uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        files: test-results.trx
```
